verses.tl: Ta'rujul-malaa'ikatu war-roohu ilayhi fee yawmin kaana miqdaaruhu khamseena alfa sanah
Yubassaroonahum yawaddul-mujrimu law yaftadee min adhaabi yawmi'idhin bibaneeh
Wa man fil-ardi jamee'an thumma yunjeeh
Wal-ladheena hum min adhaabi rabbihim mushfiqoon
Illaa alaa azwaajihim aw maa malakat aymaanuhum fa-innahum ghayru maloomeen
Famani ibtaghaa waraa'a dhaalika fa-ulaa'ika humul-aadoon
Wal-ladheena hum li'maanaatihim wa ahdihim raa'oon
Ayatma'u kullu imri'in minhum an yudkhala jannata na'eem
Falaa uqsimu birabbil-mashaariqi wal-maghaaribi innaa laqaadiroon
Alaa an nubaddila khayran minhum wa maa nahnu bimasbooqeen
Fadharhum yakhoodoo wa yal-aboo hattaa yulaaqoo yawmahumul-ladhee yoo'adoon
Yawma yakhrujoona minal-ajdaathi siraa'an ka'annahum ilaa nusubin yoofidoon
Khaashi'atan absaaruhum tarhaquhum dhillatun dhaalikal-yawmul-ladhee kaanoo yoo'adoon
